title: chore(dependencies): deduplicate devDependencies
body:
We have some duplicate dependencies since the migrations. This PR decreases that from a total of 3.5 to 3.1 GB, as it's fairly hard to find out what's duplicate and what will have the most impact.

What I've done:
- harmonise `@babel/core`
- harmonise `prop-types`
- moved webpack dependency for example building to its own "package"
- harmonise webpack versions using resolutions
